newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-CHILAVERT MISSES TWO PENALTIES IN VELEZ DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHILAVERT MISSES TWO PENALTIES IN VELEZ DEFEAT.

text.p: Goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert, who has won fame for his ability to score goals, came unstuck on Sunday when he missed two penalties in four minutes in an Argentine championship match.

The Paraguayan international, who has already converted two penalties in the championship, missed one attempt in the 79th minute and failed again in the 83rd as Velez Sarsfield were beaten 1-0 by modest Union.
Union's goal had come in the 62nd minute through Martin Perezlindo.

Chilavert, whose goalscoring example is now being followed by goalkeepers around the continent, has converted 13 penalties and free kicks during his career with Velez, helping them to win the Argentine title three times since 1993.
He also scored from a free kick for his country to earn them a 1-1 draw with Argentina in a World Cup qualifier last year.
The defeat left Velez seventh the Clausura championship, the second of the two tournaments played in the Argentine season.
Leaders River Plate, playing their fifth game of the tournament, conceeded their first goal and dropped their first points as they were held to a 1-1 draw by Deportivo Espanol.
Osvaldo Canobbio's spectacular 24th minute header for Deportivo was the first time that River goalkeeper Roberto Bonano had been beaten in 384 minutes of football.

Veteran Uruguayan international Enzo Francescoli missed a penalty for River, who won the season's Apertura or opening championship, before halftime but Roberto Montserrat salvaged a point in the second half.

Boca Juniors, who have continued to disappoint their massive and passionate following in the competition, hammered Huracan-Corrientes 4-1 to give them some encouragement for next Sunday's clash with River, their old foes.
